programs.title: Miffy and Friends
programs.desc: Miffy feels special when Melanie gives her a friendship sticker - until she discovers she's not the only one.

programs.title: The Woohoos!
programs.desc: The Woohoos think a mysterious artist has painted a beautiful squiggly pattern on Scotty's roof. They learn that slugs make slime trails which help them to go anywhere they want, and to find each other.

programs.title: Nikhil & Jay
programs.sub_title: Nikhil and Jay and the Happy Hospital
programs.desc: Nikhil and Jay make a hospital at home. They look after Nana and Jim, Amma and Appa and try lots of ways to make their patient.

programs.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
programs.desc: Teddy and Leo lose their toy cars, and since Daniel doesn't use his anymore, he gives them to the twins to enjoy. When he sees how happy his gift makes them, Daniel decides to give Margaret his old rocking chair, too.

programs.title: Mittens & Pants
programs.desc: Mittens, Scarf and Sock just got back from the big city where they saw Dogs: The Musical. They try to act itout for Pants, but it doesn't go so well, till Pants has an idea.

programs.title: BeddyByes
programs.desc: BaBa enjoys sharing with friends, but is disappointed when they have shared everything and are left with nothing. Luckily MeMo and BaBa's other kind friends enjoy sharing back.

programs.title: Mixmups
programs.desc: The Mixmups end up in the wrong adventure and don't know what to do. Can they find another way to enjoy the adventure they've ended up in?

programs.title: Ready Eddie Go!
programs.desc: Eddie, his family, Akil and Granny go to the park for a picnic. They find the perfect spot to enjoy their food, even when a surprise rain shower arrives.

programs.title: Bluey
programs.desc: After Dad eats her last chip, Bingo is given three chances to put Mum and Dad in 'Dance Mode' as payback. But the others can't resist taking Bingo's turns for her.

programs.title: Fizzy And Suds
programs.desc: Fizzy and Suds spend time with some gorgeous country cows and even see them being milked. It's also showtime - and our bubbly friends get to meet some prize-winners. MOO MOOOOO!

programs.title: The Makery
programs.desc: Garden gnomes are appearing all over The Makery! Inspired by this, Nim creates a fishing gnome picture, bakes a campfire cupcake, and makes an airport with a crafty kid.

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: Anthony's belongings have made a mess in the Wiggly lounge room. The Wiggles need to get it cleaned up for Wags' upcoming Wiggly dog dance. Will Do-Do, the cleaning robot, be able to help?
